product_name: Construction Machine Hire Fleet Operations Platform
summary: A single-user fleet operations platform for a Sydney construction machine hire business, used by one owner-operator manager through one authenticated account. It holds all 85 machines as individual assets with a full status lifecycle, runs hire agreements and bookings with double-booking conflict checks and a fleet-wide availability calendar, keeps customer records, hire history and quotes, and raises AUD invoices, hire dockets and credit notes with Australian GST at 10% shown as a separate line
